title: The Last Night Bus
summary: A tired student falls asleep on the night bus and learns something kind about the driver.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: an empty city bus at night with warm yellow lights, one young person asleep by the window, rain on the glass, no text

chapters.title: Too Late to Go Home
sentences: Kit studied at the library until it closed, and then she ran to the bus stop.
It had been a long week, and she was exhausted.
The last bus of the night arrived a few minutes later.
There were only two other passengers, and both of them were asleep.
Kit sat by the window and watched the rain run down the glass.
She promised herself that she would stay awake.
But the gentle movement of the bus made her eyes heavy.
Within minutes, she was dreaming about her exams.
When she opened her eyes again, the bus was parked and the lights were off.
She was alone, and she had no idea where she was.

chapters.title: The Driver's Surprise
sentences: Kit stood up quickly and walked to the front of the bus.
The driver was not in his seat.
Through the window, she saw him standing outside in the rain.
He was talking to an old man who was sitting on a bench.
The driver gave the man a warm coat and a hot drink from a flask.
When he returned to the bus, he looked surprised to see her.
"I am so sorry," he said. "I did not want to wake you, because you looked so tired."
"That man has no home, so I bring him something every night," he explained.
Then he drove Kit all the way to her street, even though it was not on his route.
Before she got off, she thanked him and promised to come back with a hot meal.
